Title: Implement MCP Prompts — 3 parameterized templates
Description: The MCP spec defines Prompts as reusable parameterized message templates that appear in client UIs (Claude Desktop, IDE extensions). Zero prompts exist in SplitBrain.AI. Implement 3: (1) code-review-structured: pre-fills language/focus/threshold; (2) test-generation-comprehensive: pre-fills framework/coverage/language; (3) refactor-preserve-behavior: behavioral preservation constraint baked in. Register via IPromptProvider in Orchestrator.Mcp. External agent B identified this as the most underutilized MCP primitive.
